crossRefs.note: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.
I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land.
“Prepare war against her! Arise! Let’s go up at noon. Woe to us! For the day declines, for the shadows of the evening…
“ ‘You shall not oppress your neighbor, nor rob him. “ ‘The wages of a hired servant shall not remain with you all…
In his day you shall give him his wages, neither shall the sun go down on it; for he is poor and sets his heart on it…
I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers…
Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out, and the cries of…

translations.web: As a servant who earnestly desires the shadow, as a hireling who looks for his wages,
translations.bsb: Like a slave he longs for shade; like a hireling he waits for his wages.
translations.kjv: As a servant earnestly desireth the shadow, and as an hireling looketh for the reward of his work:
translations.asv: As a servant that earnestly desireth the shadow, And as a hireling that looketh for his wages:
